description: This file implements functions for handling Python-based remote procedure calls (RPC) in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework, including serialization/deserialization, matching operators, and sending remote calls for Python functions, UDFs, and Torchscript functions.

methods.name: toPyIValue
methods.description: Converts a Message object to an IValue, handling different message types such as SCRIPT_RET and PYTHON_RET.

methods.name: matchBuiltinOp
methods.description: Matches a given operator name and arguments to a built-in operator, returning the corresponding Operator object.

methods.name: sendPythonRemoteCall
methods.description: Sends a Python remote call message to a specified worker, returning a future for the message.

methods.name: toPyJitFuture
methods.description: Converts a JitFuture containing a Message into a JitFuture containing an IValue, with error handling.

methods.name: pyRpcBuiltin
methods.description: Performs a remote call for a built-in operator with Python arguments, returning a future.

methods.name: pyRpcPythonUdf
methods.description: Performs a remote call for a Python UDF, returning a future.

methods.name: pyRpcTorchscript
methods.description: Performs a remote call for a Torchscript function, returning a future.

methods.name: pyRemoteBuiltin
methods.description: Performs a remote call for a built-in operator and returns a PyRRef.

methods.name: pyRemotePythonUdf
methods.description: Performs a remote call for a Python UDF and returns a PyRRef.

methods.name: pyRemoteTorchscript
methods.description: Performs a remote call for a Torchscript function and returns a PyRRef.
